decision.article_title: “求索”4.0上线！国内首个人工智能全产业链评测基准发布 - 第一财经
decision.reason: Yicai, citing CCTV, confirms China's cross-layer 'Qiusuo' 4.0 AI industrial test benchmark released Oct13 with unified test metrics and sector workloads. Supplier manual test applicability and evidence preflight is a model-free hypothesis; not a qualified new product.

opportunities.core_job: Map cross-layer national benchmark test requirements to prepared device/model/industrial AI product evidence and human test approvals
opportunities.target_customer: Chinese AI chip, model, infrastructure and regulated industry system vendors preparing Qiusuo 4.0 evaluation
opportunities.product_mechanism: Benchmark categories and version → component/vendor inventory → test workload and measurable metric reference → uploaded manual test output → missing case/owner/reviewer checklist
opportunities.why_now: China announced Qiusuo 4.0 on 13 Oct 2026, a cross-industry benchmarking system covering computing chips, models, applications and AI security with unified metrics and sector workloads
opportunities.before_state: Hardware, model and downstream safety acceptance evidence sit across labs with inconsistent benchmark version and environment notes
opportunities.after_state: Exportable trace of benchmark clause to test run and independently signed evidence, no AI model needed
